entries.land_description: The Waxing Moon Healing Village is a recently formed society with the purpose of creating a womyn's sanctuary with emphasis on a relaxed lifestyle and harmonious cooperation for self healing, regeneration, personal growth and development of skills. We envision an inexpensive home base for independent womyn of all ages, races, whether retired or working, in a peaceful rural setting.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members/residents, nonlesbian women, possibly girl/boy children, males, dogs (all of this is still being worked on)
entries.notes: We are an active women's land group but no land yet.

entries.land_description: Womland Trust is a non-profit corporation with a home office in Maine, but our membership comes from all parts of the country. Our goal is to protect mother earth and to reclaim her for use by womn and children. We'll begin by acquiring property in Maine, but our plans include a world-wide webwork.
entries.welcomed_groups: support and are open to all like-minded womn
entries.notes: We are an active group, but no land yet.

entries.land_description: [This is not women's land.] We just celebrated 20 years on our 400 acre farm. Three businesses (including $1 million in hammocks and furniture) provide our income. We build our buildings, grow 50% of our food, cut wood and build solar for heat, provide childcare and education, and repair our cars and appliances. Several Q's groups and activities provide support. Connections with lesbians in nearby cities. Annual Q's Gathering. We are ALWAYS looking for new members, especially lesbians.
entries.welcomed_groups: visitors (day tours or 3-week visits), new members/residents, girl/boy children (sometimes), nonlesbian women, males
entries.notes: We are/have: 13 permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, woods, farmland, camping space, women and men living on the land.

entries.street_address: 999 First Coast Hwy W, (located at Amelia Island Yacht Club)
entries.land_description: Sea Kindly specializes in customized sailing charters onboard a 1986 Pearson 33' mastheaded sloop. Your days can be spent learning basic boat handling and navigating...exploring islands and beaches...or just laying back and enjoying a picturesque sunrise or sunset. Whatever you desire on your vacation, Sea Kindly will accommodate your schedule, trip and meals. Your charter is private. We offer special access to Cumberland Island National Seashore spring through fall and the Everglades in winter with Capt Carol.

We offer a food space for Q with an ambiance of lesbian culture. Home-cooked vegetarian meals daily, noon - 9pm. Pure raw honey, organic herbs, fruits and vegetables in season, home-made seitan (wheat-meat) and soysage, fresh baked breads and sweets, organic chicken eggs.
entries.notes: We have: camping space, vegetarian meals for Q only.

entries.land_description: Sailing and island vacation trips in "old Florida." Sail in protected Charlotte Harbor and the Gulf of Mexico watching dolphins and tropical birds. Vacation in inexpensive gulf beach cabins or tents on a 6-mile undeveloped state park barrier island accessible by boat only. Shell, swim, sunbathe, relax. Or learn to sail, 3 & 6-day courses for women. Hands-on instruction, live on board, meals included.

We are a newly-forming women's spirituality group based on the premise that in our diversity lies our strength. Celebrations will incorporate women's rituals from a variety of religious traditions and will center around the honoring of women's relationships to each other and the worlds around them. Friday evening potlucks are scheduled for sharing food, stories, and music.
entries.notes: Se habla espanol. We are in an active group with no land yet.

entries.land_description: Mountain Mama is a one Q organization dedicated to providing a wonderful experience of Q on horseback in the wilderness. We have excellent horses and beautiful places to see. We provide intensive study of horses, packing, camping and survival skills in the New Mexico wilderness. Topics include packing horse packs, grooming of horses, use of saddles and equipment, horse safety, mountain vegetation and wildlife, camping survival skills, wilderness cooking, fishing, map reading, trail finding, and fun. Group and individual trips available.
entries.welcomed_groups: girl/boy children, nonlesbian women, males, dogs
entries.notes: We are/have: 3 permanent structures, accessible, plumbing, electricity, camping space.

entries.land_description: Mariah is a women-owned and operated Whitewater Rafting and Wilderness Tours company providing a safe and supportive environment where women can explore their physical and inner strengths in an outdoor setting. Trips are geared for the novice through experienced outdoorswoman, and are 2-28 days in length. Trips include: rafting the Grand Canyon, Costa Rica, Rogue and California rivers; seak kayaking in Baja; horsepacking in the Grand Tetons; trekking in Nepal.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members/residents, girl/boy children (age 8 minimum), nonlesbian women, males
